title: Settlement Agreements Consumer Terms: Accepting a Written Offer and Offer Expiry
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Acceptance and Expiry of an Offer

**1. Who accepts.** Only the consumer can accept a settlement under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, and acceptance is the consumer's own act on the written offer.

**2. Accepting in time.** An offer is accepted only when the handling date is no later than the offer's last day counted from its offer date. The offer's last day is the offer date plus the programme's offer validity period in calendar days, the day after the offer date being day one and the last day included; it is the offer expiry date shown on the offer.

**3. How the consumer accepts.** Acceptance on a recorded call is valid only where the programme allows recorded-call acceptance; elsewhere the consumer accepts by electronic signature or in the online portal.

**4. Due dates on acceptance.** On acceptance the first payment due date is recomputed as the acceptance date plus the same number of days the offer allowed, never more than the programme's first-payment window, and later due dates follow at the offer's payment interval.

> Clause 4 is **no longer in force** for a Three-Payment Settlement accepted on a recorded call and for a Hardship Settlement accepted by electronic signature; for those acceptances it is superseded by the current acceptance-window basis for each.

**5. Booking the amount.** The settlement amount is booked to the settlement once, on the acceptance date, and only for a settlement whose status is accepted.

**6. Expiry.** An offer still offered after its offer expiry date expires on the next day, and an expired offer can never be accepted; the consumer may receive a new offer under the re-offer rules.

## Boundary cases for clause 2 (hypothetical, 30-day validity)

| Day of the consumer's acceptance | Result |
|---|---|
| The offer date itself | accepted in time |
| The 30th calendar day after the offer date (the expiry date) | accepted in time |
| The 31st calendar day after the offer date | not accepted; the offer expired that day |

## Points of judgement

- **Can the agent accept on the consumer's behalf?** No. Acceptance is the consumer's own act on the written offer.
- **Is the settlement amount booked when the offer is made?** No. It is booked once, on the acceptance date, to a settlement in status accepted.
- **Does a consumer whose offer expired lose any chance to settle?** No; a new offer may follow under the re-offer rules, but the expired offer itself can never be accepted.

superseded_clauses: On acceptance the first payment due date is recomputed as the acceptance date plus the same number of days the offer allowed, never more than first_payment_max_days_after_acceptance, and later due dates follow at payment_interval_days.
